summary: Iteration 3 — Frontend testing of P2 batch (difficulty levels, persistent achievements, 3 new recipes). 47/48 critical assertions PASS on mobile 414x896. Home: achievements-strip + achievements-link visible showing '0 of 8 unlocked'; header has both TROPHIES + SANDBOX buttons; recipes grid shows exactly 7 non-flagship cards plus flagship card. /achievements: page loads with 8-badge grid (all initially Locked), badge-count='0', back-home link present, reset-stats hidden when count==0 then appears after unlock; reset-confirm wipes localStorage ('unlocked':[]) and resets count to 0 without errors. DifficultyPicker present on all 3 sims (/simulator, /simulator/boiled-rice, /simulator/saucepan-heating) with diff-easy/normal/hard; only one active at a time (border-current class swap verified); picker locks (disabled=true) once sim transitions out of stage 0. Cheese sim achievement flow: drove stages 0→1→2 (auto)→3→4→5, waited ~6.5s real for simSec≈156 in perfect window 120-210 on NORMAL, tapped ctrl-take-out → outcome 'PERFECT!' rendered; achievement-banner DOM appeared (data-testid='achievement-banner'); localStorage 'cot.stats.v1' updated to {cheese.plays:1, cheese.perfects:1, unlocked:['first-toast']}. Persistence verified: navigated home (strip showed '1 OF 8 UNLOCKED'), back to /achievements (badge-count='1', badge-first-toast no longer has Lock icon). Three new recipes all load: /recipe/scrambled-eggs (5 steps, 4 ingredients, 3 warnings), /recipe/simple-pasta (5 steps, 6 ingredients, 3 warnings), /recipe/beans-on-toast (5 steps, 4 ingredients, 3 warnings). beans-on-toast has open-sandbox-from-recipe CTA linking to /simulator/saucepan-heating. No horizontal overflow on /achievements or any new recipe page at 414x896.
critical_code_review_comments: AchievementBanner auto-dismisses after 4.5s — for testing reliability, consider exposing a data attribute on the banner with badge IDs (e.g. data-badges='first-toast,golden-master') so automated tests can verify without text scraping a transient overlay. Currently the badge name text inside the banner is verifiable but timing-sensitive against animate-rise.

achievements.js getStats merges defensively — good. But `recordOutcome` mutates the result of getStats() in-place; since getStats returns a fresh object from JSON.parse, this is safe. Worth a one-line comment to make intent obvious.

Three new recipes (scrambled-eggs, simple-pasta, beans-on-toast) all reuse ASSETS.friedRice or ASSETS.cheeseToast as image — not breaking but the recipe cards on Home will look visually duplicated (e.g. boiled-rice / fried-rice / scrambled-eggs / simple-pasta all share the same fried-rice photo, and beans-on-toast shares the cheese-toast photo). Recommend unique imagery for visual differentiation.

DifficultyPicker uses `border-current` for the active state which matches the text color — works, but the inactive state uses `border-white/30 text-foreground/60` which on the brand-perfect green active item could be hard to scan at a glance. Visual is acceptable, no fix needed.

Simulator.jsx finish() pulls difficulty thresholds inline (perfLo/perfHi) — these magic numbers (90/150/120/200/210/240) live next to the PHASES array (which still uses fixed 120-210 for the 'TAKE IT OUT!' label). On EASY/HARD the on-screen phase label will be inconsistent with the actual perfect window. Minor UX glitch, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Clears localStorage 'cot.stats.v1' at start of run; reset flow used to wipe at end. No backend seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P2 features (difficulty pickers, achievements with localStorage, AchievementBanner overlay, 3 new recipes) work correctly on mobile 414x896. Cheese-sim PERFECT outcome reliably triggers at ~6.5 real-seconds after clicking ctrl-grill on NORMAL difficulty (simSec advances 24/sec; perfect window 120-210). The one soft-failure was a banner text scrape that the banner content might not be fully painted during the rise animation — the banner element WAS detected. localStorage shape verified: {cheese:{plays,perfects,fires,nukes,hardPerfects},rice:{...},pan:{...},unlocked:[badgeIds]}. Reset confirm/cancel works as expected, hides reset button once count==0. To unlock other badges quickly for regression: rice perfect via /simulator/boiled-rice (switch to LOW after boil, wait for water<10%), pan perfect via /simulator/saucepan-heating (MED + periodic stirring), chaos badge via fire/nuke outcome on cheese sim (let timer run past 240).
rca of the issue: No critical issues. Soft fail: 'Banner mentions First Perfect Toast' — banner DOM element was visible (preceding assertion passed) and localStorage confirmed unlock, but inner_text() captured during the entry animation likely returned partial/empty content. Not a real bug; if needed, main agent could expose a `data-badge-ids` attribute on the banner for stable test scraping.
